About the Business: 
KFM Geotech Pty Ltd is a reputable geotechnical, environmental, and groundwater engineering consulting firm based in Castle Hill, NSW. Founded by Dr. Mohammad Hossein Bazyar, we deliver comprehensive site investigations, construction phase support, pavement design, foundation engineering, contamination assessments, and hydrogeological services to builders, developers, architects, engineers, and government clients across New South Wales. Committed to excellence, innovation, integrity, and sustainability, we prioritise high-quality, timely, and budget-conscious solutions that ensure safe, compliant, and successful development projects while fostering a collaborative and supportive workplace culture.
About the Position: 
The Civil Engineer plays a pivotal role in delivering expert geotechnical and civil engineering solutions that underpin safe and efficient construction projects at KFM Geotech Pty Ltd. This position involves conducting site investigations, providing construction-phase support, designing foundations and pavements, assessing environmental and groundwater conditions, and ensuring all deliverables meet regulatory standards and client requirements in a dynamic consulting environment.
Key Responsibilities:
•	Conduct geotechnical site investigations, soil/rock testing, and analysis to inform foundation, retaining wall, and pavement designs.
•	Provide construction-phase geotechnical support, including excavation monitoring, bearing capacity assessments, and on-site inspections.
•	Prepare detailed technical reports, drawings, and recommendations for clients, councils, and stakeholders.
•	Perform environmental and groundwater assessments, including contamination and hydrogeological evaluations.
•	Collaborate with project teams, clients, and regulatory bodies to ensure compliance with Australian standards and project timelines.
•	Contribute to project management, risk assessments, and continuous improvement of geotechnical practices.
Requirements:
•	Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
•	Minimum Bachelor Degree in Civil Engineering (or equivalent).
•	Minimum 2-3 years of experience as a civil engineer, preferably in geotechnical consulting or construction.
•	Strong technical skills in geotechnical analysis, foundation design, site investigation, and report writing.

C Signs Pty Ltd is the premier provider of commercial and industrial signage solutions in Karratha and the broader Pilbara region. We’re committed to delivering superior signage solutions to Pilbara businesses, leveraging cutting-edge technology and our team’s expertise to ensure high-quality project completion.

Since commencing operations in 2024, the company has experienced significant growth; to support this and meet increasing client demand, we are seeking an experienced Graphic Designer to join our team in Karratha, Western Australia, on a full-time basis.

As a Graphic Designer, your everyday responsibilities will include:
• Creating graphic design assets and elements for the company’s brand identity, including logos, letterheads, email signatures, promotional material, social media content and other marketing and communication collateral.
• Creating graphic design layouts and diagrams based on prior consultation with the clients and the analysis of their visual communication requirements.
• Creating brand identities and original artwork for new businesses, including elements like logos, colour palettes and typography, based on the client’s strategy and vision, and its later application across different projects and media.
• Preparing and optimising artwork files for small and large format printing, vinyl cutting, router cutting and other signage production processes.
• Managing client feedback, revisions and approvals throughout the design process.
• Following workflow processes and keeping an organised record of each client’s files to ensure all future work aligns with their brand guidelines across different projects and media.
• Proficient use of Adobe Creative Cloud applications, including Illustrator and Photoshop (essential). Experience with Adobe Lightroom & InDesign is desirable.
• Liaising with clients and suppliers. 

Desirable Skills and Experience - but not mandatory:
• Knowledge and understanding of signage materials, production and installation requirements to assist clients and develop practical and effective visual communication solutions that are suitable for manufacture and application; ie. printed media, illuminated displays, rigid signage, vehicle graphics, marketing and events displays, etc.
• Knowledge of printing software (Roland and HP) and operation of large format printers, vinyl plotters and router cutting machines is highly desirable. 

It is essential to hold a relevant Bachelor’s Degree or higher qualification in Graphic Design, Visual Communication or a related field, or possess a minimum of five years’ relevant industry experience.

This is a full-time position offering a salary package between $85,000 and $105,000 plus superannuation, dependent on qualifications and experience. If you believe you could be a great fit for the above role, then please send us your most up to date resume and any relevant certificates and licensing by email to admin@csigns.com.au.

Please note that due to the anticipated volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

result.description:
ABN AMRO Clearing (AAC) is a leading global player in clearing and clearing related services and strives to optimize profitability, return on invested capital and shareholders value. We have offices around the world, operating in Sydney since 1998; other main offices are located in Hong Kong, Tokyo, Singapore, Amsterdam, London, Chicago and Brazil. AAC is ambitious and customer oriented, striving to provide the best integrated service package for the professional business. AAC is a reliable partner, with efficient operations, compliant to all regulations and with a sound risk framework. 

The Software Engineer role contributes to AAC’s mission to optimize performance, risk management, and operational excellence by designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise software systems. The position ensures that applications are scalable, reliable, and compliant with financial regulations across APAC. 

The Software Engineer will report to the RAMS APAC Product Owner and be responsible for end-to-end design, development, migration, and optimization of critical clearing applications. This includes: 
• Designing system architecture for applications across Linux, Windows, PostgreSQL, MS SQL, and DB2 environments. 
• Leading upgrades and migrations of legacy applications to modern frameworks (Java, Angular, Python, Perl). 
• Ensuring integration, scalability, performance, and maintainability across APAC platforms. 

Key Responsibilities:
1. Software System Design & Architecture 
o Design and implement robust, scalable software architectures for LCM applications. 
o Evaluate and select frameworks, tools, and technologies to optimize system performance. 
o Define database structures and interactions to support enterprise systems. 
2. Development & Engineering 
o Develop, test, and maintain software solutions in Java, Python, Perl, and Angular, aligned with architectural design. 
o Apply engineering best practices (Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Maven, Bootstrap CSS) to ensure maintainable and high-quality code. 
3. Application Lifecycle Management 
o Own the full software lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, deployment, and support. 
o Lead migration projects, upgrading legacy systems to modern platforms while maintaining system integrity. 
4. Technical Leadership & Advisory 
o Provide guidance to Product Owners and the RAMS team on system design, technical decisions, and software strategy. 
o Evaluate software solutions for cost, risk, scalability, and integration into existing APAC systems. 
5. Collaboration & Documentation 
o Work closely with IT teams, Chapter Leads, and APAC CIO to maintain alignment between business needs and software architecture. 
o Produce and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and user manuals. 
6. Risk & Compliance Awareness 
o Ensure all system designs meet regulatory, security, and operational risk requirements. 
o Implement solutions to improve reliability, compliance, and performance of critical clearing systems. 

Required Knowledge and Experience Education: 
• IT-related university degree or equivalent. 
• At least 2+ years in software engineering or system architecture roles. 
• Experience in finance/clearing systems preferred. 

Technical Skills: 
• Software engineering and system architecture experience. 
• Programming: Java (mandatory), Python/Perl, Angular. 
• Frameworks: Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Maven, Bootstrap CSS. 
• Databases: PostgreSQL, MS SQL, DB2, including design and optimization. 
• Operating Systems: Linux, Windows, Unix. 
• Lifecycle management, software engineering methodologies, test management, and IT governance.
